title: Pausing any single token blocks ALL claims via DoS -- inconsistency between claim() and calculateClaimAmount()
description: claim() at line 589 reverts with TokenIsPaused() for ANY paused token in the loop. But calculateClaimAmount() at line 803 uses continue to skip paused tokens. This inconsistency means pausing one token blocks all claims.
impact: Pausing a single low-value token (e.g., during a depeg event) prevents claiming yield from ALL strategies. calculateClaimAmount() returns a misleading value that cannot actually be claimed. Blocks ClaimArbitrage and all claimers.
attackPath: Admin pauses a single low-value stablecoin token (e.g., during a depeg event)
calculateClaimAmount() reports claimable yield (skips paused token with continue)
User or ClaimArbitrage calls claim() expecting to receive the reported yield
claim() hits the paused token and reverts with TokenIsPaused()
All claims are blocked for all strategies, not just the paused token
recommendation: Change claim() to skip paused tokens with continue (matching calculateClaimAmount() behavior). If all-or-nothing is intentional, update calculateClaimAmount() to also revert.

relatedCode.description: claim() reverts with TokenIsPaused() for any paused token
calculateClaimAmount() uses continue to skip paused tokens
